notes: This intentionally incomplete template cannot enable perception or motion. Never substitute simulated camera parameters.
First pair the camera in preview-only mode. Copy its exact source dimensions and exposed settings, including device_id, into this file.
Measure intrinsics K and OpenCV distortion for that exact rear lens, source resolution, zoom and browser processing mode using a physical calibration target.
K is in full source-image pixels. Select a bounded output with the exact same aspect ratio; the phone resizes the whole source without rotation, mirror or crop.
Measure rigid T_base_camera in metres: base +X forward,+Y left,+Z up with floor z=0; optical +X right,+Y down,+Z forward. Confirm mount height and downward pitch physically.
Fix the mount and prevent lens, zoom, stabilization and crop changes. A changed source, orientation, geometry or pinned setting requires a new map and perception session.
Set verified=true only after reprojection and known floor-distance checks on held-out physical images pass.

Browser requestVideoFrameCallback provides presentation metadata, not exact exposure. Independently measure a conservative maximum sensor-to-callback age under load on this exact device/settings and enter max_pipeline_age_s.
Keep timing.validated=false until that bound has been tested, including exposure, browser buffering, encoder, Wi-Fi jitter and reconnects. Unknown timing blocks real motion.

The adapter labels challenge time minus the measured pipeline bound as an acquisition-time lower bound. Read-time age includes challenge, encode, upload and host processing delays. This is never claimed as exact exposure.
Run camera, floor, watchdog, steering, braking and manual-stop checks with wheels lifted before any supervised floor trial. This file alone does not validate motor calibration.
